entities.name: 2019 Colombia DC-3 crash
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: On 9 March 2019, a Douglas DC-3 operated by Latinoamericana de Servicios Aéreo crashed near San Carlos de Guaroa, Colombia. The plane was on a flight from Jorge Enrique González Torres Airport, San José del Guaviare to La Vanguardia Airport, Villavicencio. All 14 people on board were killed, including the mayor of Taraira. The crew were attempting to land at Villavicencio and had just declared an emergency.
